verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents built-in workflows, a GraphQL API and GitHub Actions automation, so the overage axis applies. However, no evidence item says what happens when automation or API limits are exceeded: no extra charges, throttling, rate-limit responses or hard stops. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
